items.subject: Greater London Authority is hiring a Senior Project Officer – New Homes Accelerator
items.summary: New vacancies include a Greater London Authority senior housing delivery role plus council housing, tenancy, licensing and building-safety roles in Crawley, Brent and Haringey.
items.action: Review the Greater London Authority role first, then compare the Crawley, Brent and Haringey roles’ salaries, requirements, closing dates and commutes before deciding whether to apply.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether any of the newly listed public-sector housing roles is worth applying for.
